name: Inter Globe Finance Limited
about: Inter Globe Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financial services in India. The company offers micro, small, and medium enterprise/small and medium enterprise finance; loan syndication; project finance; ECB/ICDs; IPO funding; loan against property and shares; mortgages; construction/infrastructure/medical/IT/equipment finance; and working capital, two-wheeler, and business loans. It also provides financial management and advisory services. The company serves share broking houses, logistics, integrated steel plants, real estate developers, infrastructure conglomerates, airport ground handling services, retail marts, and power sector, as well as iron ore mine industries. Inter Globe Finance Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
